result.summary: The page is generally coherent, but there are a few layout issues caused by horizontal content overflow and the fixed bottom navigation obscuring content.

issues.description: The horizontally scrolling category and restaurant carousels are visibly clipped at the right edge, including a partial category chip and truncated “Trattoria Picco...” card.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the carousel has clear horizontal-scroll affordance and appropriate right-side spacing, or constrain and paginate the content so partially visible items do not look accidentally cut off.

issues.description: The second restaurant card in the “Popular right now” section continues underneath the fixed bottom navigation, leaving its image and likely content obscured.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page or adjust the fixed navigation layering so the final cards can be fully viewed above the navigation bar.

issues.description: The third restaurant title is truncated to “Trattoria Picco...” at the viewport edge, which may appear like missing content rather than an intentional carousel truncation.
issues.suggestion: Use a controlled text ellipsis within the card width and provide horizontal scrolling or a detail view for the full restaurant name.
